Question B-003-014-005.

Why the correct answer is right: Voice-operated transmit (VOX) switching keys the transmitter automatically when microphone audio is detected.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "VXO": A variable crystal oscillator (VXO) provides limited frequency tuning from a crystal-controlled circuit, not voice-operated transmit control.
- sourceIndex 2: "VCO": A voltage-controlled oscillator (VCO) changes frequency in response to a control voltage, not to microphone audio.
- sourceIndex 3: "VFO": A variable-frequency oscillator (VFO) provides adjustable tuning, not automatic transmit keying when the operator speaks.
